subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: India won the ICC Cricket World Cup (ODI format) for the second time in the year:
explanation: India won the ODI World Cup in 1983 (first title) and again in 2011, hosted jointly with Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. 2007 was India's T20 World Cup win, a different format.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports & Awards — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Kailash Satyarthi, an Indian child-rights activist, was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2014 jointly with:
explanation: Kailash Satyarthi and Malala Yousafzai (Pakistan) shared the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize for their work on children's rights and education. Mother Teresa won it separately in 1979; Amartya Sen won the Economics prize in 1998.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports & Awards — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: India's best-ever performance at a single Paralympic Games, winning a record medal haul, occurred at the:
explanation: India achieved its best-ever Paralympic medal tally (29 medals) at Paris 2024, surpassing the earlier record set at Tokyo 2020.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Sports & Awards — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The first Telugu writer to receive the Jnanpith Award (India's highest literary honour) was:
explanation: Viswanatha Satyanarayana became the first Telugu Jnanpith awardee in 1970, for his epic 'Ramayana Kalpavrikshamu'. C. Narayana Reddy (1988) and Ravuri Bharadwaja (2012) received it later.
